rationale: The assistant asserted that 'Bosch 24' was a 24-inch size instead of asking whether 24 was a display code or part of the model number. It also gave US-centric advice (garbage disposal, air gap) and listed generic F-codes. After the customer clarified, it correctly identified E:24 as a drain fault and guided filter cleaning, which fixed the problem with no unnecessary parts. Safety was weak: it did not tell the customer to unplug the machine and wear gloves before reaching into the sump when glass was involved, though it did advise a check for remaining shards.
